id.instruksi: Pilah tiap kejadian: air mendidih, atau air menguap.
id.b-didih: mendidih: gelembung di seluruh cairan, pada suhu didih
id.b-uap: menguap: hanya di permukaan, pada suhu berapa pun
id.i-panci: air di panci bergelembung besar di atas kompor
id.i-seratus: termometer di air bergolak tetap 100 °C walau api dibesarkan
id.i-genangan: genangan di jalan hilang setelah siang
id.i-piring: air di piring berkurang setelah beberapa hari
id.i-tambak: air laut di tambak garam berkurang dijemur

en.instruksi: Sort each event: water is boiling, or water is evaporating.
en.b-didih: boiling: bubbles all through the liquid, at the boiling point
en.b-uap: evaporating: only at the surface, at any temperature
en.i-panci: water in a pan on the stove bubbles hard
en.i-ketel: a kettle whistles on the stove
en.i-seratus: the thermometer in bubbling water stays at 100 °C even on a bigger flame
en.i-genangan: a puddle on the road is gone by the afternoon
en.i-piring: water in a dish goes down over a few days
en.i-tambak: seawater in a salt pan shrinks in the sun
